themes.title: Populist Right Battles Media Bias and Digital Censorship
themes.blurb: Right-wing figures and parties in Sweden and the United States continue to challenge perceived censorship and media bias. While Sweden Democrats protest exclusion from local social media forums, the Trump administration threatens press regulators and conducts surveillance on media figures.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Local SD representatives protest being banned from community Facebook groups, framing digital platform moderation as an attack on democratic speech.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump threatens news anchors with FCC sanctions while federal agencies face scrutiny for secretly monitoring journalists and civil society organizations.

themes.title: Debates Intensify Over Far-Right Normalization and Executive Power
themes.blurb: Political observers and critics in Sweden and the United States highlight the mainstreaming of right-wing political power alongside aggressive executive action. As Sweden's far right achieves sustained political normalization, the US administration pushes unilateral executive orders spanning land privatization, renamings, and legal challenges to state policies.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Media commentary and activists reflect on a decade of political shifts that led to the normalization and electoral prominence of Sweden's far right.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump expands executive power through unilateral geographical renamings, proposed national park land swaps, and federal lawsuits against state-level policies.
